title: An Intelligent Budget Management Mobile Application Based on a Recurrent Neural Network
authors: Ghonaim, W. A.; El-Sharawy, E. E.
venue: International Journal of Theoretical and Applied Research
tldr: Proposes an intelligent mobile budget management app using RNN for financial transaction risk classification, achieving 97.45% accuracy with Arabic and English language support.
problem_and_motivation: Existing budgeting apps lack AI-based forecasting and Arabic language support. Users need intelligent tools that classify transaction risk levels and provide personalized financial guidance.
approach: Developed an Android mobile application with RNN-based financial transaction classifier.
Trained on real-world financial dataset with preprocessing including normalization and transformation.
Classifies transactions into low, medium, and high-risk categories.
Supports both English and Arabic language interfaces.
Evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics.
findings: num: Overall accuracy of 97.45% on new test data.
num: Precision, recall, and F1 measures all above 0.97 for all risk categories.
System reliably detects both low-risk and high-risk financial behaviors.
Arabic language support fills a gap in existing budgeting applications.
